youtube.title: Missed Call Text Back for Plumbers: What the Text Should Say (Part 1 of 3)
youtube.description:
Missed call text back for plumbing, HVAC and electrical business owners: the words, part 1 of 3.
Twilio, "How long can a message be?" (https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-sms-character-limit): a single GSM-7 text holds 160 characters; an emoji or a curly quotation mark switches the text to UCS-2, where a single text holds 70; a longer message is split into segments, and Twilio bills per segment.

The text (an example, 102 characters):
Hi, this is Sam the plumber. Sorry I missed your call. What do you need fixed, and when works for you?

Steps:
1. Who you are: your name and trade.
2. Sorry I missed your call.
3. One question that books the job (what needs fixing, and when).
4. Count it: under 160 characters, no emoji, no curly quotes.

Next: part 2, turning it on.
Send this to whoever answers your phones.
What a missed call costs you, worked out: https://proofnotfluff.com/missed-call-cost-calculator/
